### When Your Walk Feels More Like a Crawl - Encouragement Café - July 7
Author: Britta Lafont
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/when-your-walk-feels-more-like-a-crawl-encouragement-cafe-july-7.html
Passage: John 4:50
Points:
- Genuine faith means stepping out completely in trust rather than hesitating to see if obedience feels comfortable.
- Laying down our own desire for control feels counterintuitive, but yielding to God restores true fellowship.
- Even when our spiritual walk feels sluggish or stuck, God is still actively working within us.
- Like the official who took Jesus at His word, we often later discover God was already accomplishing His promise.
- Believers should avoid comparing their progress to others and rest thankful in God's ongoing work in their hearts.
